title: Combine Overlapping Ranges
prompt:
You are given a slice of closed ranges, each written as a tuple `(start, end)` with start <= end. Merge every group of ranges that overlap or touch (share an endpoint) and return the resulting ranges sorted by start. The input is not necessarily sorted.

Signature: `fn merge_ranges(ranges: &[(i32, i32)]) -> Vec<(i32, i32)>`

Example:
  merge_ranges(&[(8, 10), (1, 3), (2, 6), (15, 18), (18, 20)])
  -> [(1, 6), (8, 10), (15, 20)]
